name: option-wheel
title: Option Wheel
description: A vertical wheel of word options arranged on an arc. Scrolling, dragging or arrow keys spin it with momentum, and the item at rest sits sharp and white while its neighbours tilt and blur.
use: A short list of labels should feel tactile and playful rather than a plain dropdown.
avoid: The curved blurred wheel takes vertical space and hides most options, so long lists are hard to scan.
a11y: Arrow keys and listbox roles work, but the container removes its outline and shows no visible focus indicator. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Genre names stack down an invisible arc on the left of a black stage, sharpest and white in the middle and fading to grey, tilted and blurred above and below. A large title and a small instruction sit to the right.
behaves: Scrolling, dragging or the arrow keys roll the list with eased momentum; the chosen word snaps to the middle, turns white and grows. Neighbouring words lean away, dim and blur, and the readout on the right updates.
customise: Items, default selection, change handler, text and active colours, side, font size, spacing, curve, tilt, blur, fade, opacity floor, smoothing, inset, loop, draggable, tick sound and volume are props.
weight: light: One rAF loop lays out a dozen text rows and stops once the wheel settles.
demo: Music genres including Ambient, House, Techno, Jazz, Lo-Fi, Synthwave, Trance, Funk, Disco and Drum & Bass.
issues: The wheel is keyboard operable but shows no focus ring, so its focused state is invisible.
polishWhy: Strong curved typography and smooth blur; the dim distant options nearly vanish.
